How this concept plays

A local variable exists only inside the function or block that declares it. The ten labs use ten different interactive mechanics: ordering, token assembly, flowchart wiring, variable vaults, sorting, bug hunting, scope placement, robot programming, pair matching, repair, tracing, and state simulation. Every lab is authored for this concept and stored locally in its challenge bank.

CP1 pages run one focused lab each. They are not multiple-choice quizzes and they do not call a remote service. The shared DOM runtime renders the mechanic; the concept bank supplies the content.

Ten authored labs, ten mechanics. Content and runtime are local. Weeks 9–14 are a finals extension beyond the week-8 syllabus.
